title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Vannathi confronts Pandian over a status picture. Meanwhile, shockwaves hit the household when Chandayatha abruptly takes over the family's monthly budget.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Kasthuri hands over her chain to Karthik for his college fees after Karikalan refuses to pay. Meanwhile, Pooja steps up to support Karikalan in a supermarket mishap.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Vennila plots Rajasekar's murder with her accomplice during his 60th wedding anniversary. Kanmani's beauty mesmerises Anbu as she prepares for the anniversary celebration.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Saravanan rushes a labouring Thangamayil to the hospital for an emergency C-section. Joy fills the air as she delivers a baby boy, leaving Saravanan moved to tears!

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Joy sweeps through the family as the doctor confirms Meena's pregnancy! A thrilled Muthu shares the news while Vijaya warmly blesses and advises the mother-to-be.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: The Race to Finale Phase 3 continues with the contestants delivering power-packed performances. Tune in as one singer earns the Golden Buzzer and becomes the second finalist!

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Abinaya bars Vetri from the PTM, and he asks Sudar's teacher to insist that both parents attend. At school, Diya exposes Magesh's poor communication.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman catches Ayyapan at the temple, but Rishi strikes Paraman to stop his confession about Ashok's murder. After hospital recovery, Paraman confronts Rishi about saving Ayyapan.
